tagline: Try any Flipper Zero firmware in your browser before flashing it to your real device.
status: Pre-alpha. The emulator core is not wired into this page yet (milestone M3). Nothing on this page emulates a device.
positioning: dryflash is a smoke test, not a hardware certification. It catches boot failures, crashes, faults, hangs and broken UI flows. It does not reproduce real RF, NFC/RFID physics, BLE, power behaviour or exact timing. Passing in the emulator does not guarantee the firmware works on hardware.
